headlines.title: Abbott, Dexcom grapple with diabetes coverage ahead of planned Medicare expansion
headlines.summary: Abbott said it is facing pricing pressure and slower growth ahead of a planned coverage expansion for people with Type 2 diabetes. Competitor Dexcom, however, did not experience the same slowdown.

headlines.title: Dexcom Invites the Global Diabetes Community to Share Their Stories Through A Letter to Diabetes Campaign
headlines.summary: SAN DIEGO, November 02, 2026--DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXCM), the global leader in glucose biosensing, today launched A Letter to Diabetes in honor of National Diabetes Awareness Month and World Diabetes Day, creating a platform for people around the world to put into words everything they’ve wanted to say about their diabetes journey, from the heartfelt and humorous to the hopeful and unexpected.

headlines.title: Dexcom lifts 2026 revenue outlook after positive Q3
headlines.summary: Dexcom now expects 2026 revenues to land in the $5.2bn to $5.25bn range, up from $5.18bn at the low-end as previously outlined.

headlines.title: DXCM Q3 deep dive: clinical momentum and new product launches support growth trajectory
headlines.summary: Medical device company DexCom (NASDAQ:DXCM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 11.2% year on year to $1.34 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $5.23 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.73 per share was 8.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: DexCom (DXCM) Stock Looks Below Fair Value on Cash Flow
headlines.summary: DexCom has enjoyed a strong run over the past year, yet the share price still leaves a basic question on the table for investors who care about cash flows. With the stock now trading around US$82.29, the issue is whether the underlying stream of future cash the business can produce really lines up with that tag. Over the past 5 years the stock has declined 48.2%, which puts extra focus on whether the current valuation is now more closely tied to the cash it can throw off over time.

description: DexCom, Inc., a medical device company, focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems for the management of diabetes and metabolic health in the United States and internationally. The company offers Dexcom G7 and G7 15 Day, an integrated continuous glucose monitoring system; Dexcom G6, a CGM system; Dexcom ONE+ to replace fingerstick blood glucose testing for diabetes treatment decisions; Stelo, a biosensor designed for adults with prediabetes and Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin; Dexcom Share, a remote monitoring system; and Dexcom Follow application. It markets its products directly to endocrinologists, physicians, and diabetes educators. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
